name: Control Panel Mount Plate
description: 100 x 70 x 3 mm control panel plate: two 22 mm pushbutton holes, a 50 x 20 mm display window, rounded corners, and four M4 mounting holes.

steps.instruction: Create the panel plate: 100 mm long (X), 70 mm wide (Y) and 3 mm thick (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.

transcript.user_prompt: Create the panel plate: 100 mm long (X), 70 mm wide (Y) and 3 mm thick (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the 100 x 70 mm panel blank, 3 mm thick, centered on the origin.

steps.instruction: Round the four vertical corner edges of the panel with 5 mm fillets.

transcript.user_prompt: Round the four vertical corner edges of the panel with 5 mm fillets.
transcript.assistant_message: I rounded the panel corners with 5 mm fillets.

steps.instruction: Cut two 22 mm pushbutton holes of radius 11.15 mm (22.3 mm panel cutout) through the plate at (X, Y) = (+/-28, -15).

transcript.user_prompt: Cut two 22 mm pushbutton holes of radius 11.15 mm (22.3 mm panel cutout) through the plate at (X, Y) = (+/-28, -15).
transcript.assistant_message: I cut the two standard 22 mm pushbutton holes in the lower half of the panel — industrial buttons or an e-stop snap straight in.

steps.instruction: Cut a rectangular display window, 50 mm long (X) by 20 mm tall (Y), through the plate centered at (0, 15).

transcript.assistant_message: I cut the 50 x 20 mm display window in the upper half — sized for a small LCD or OLED module.

steps.instruction: Drill four M4 mounting holes of radius 2.1 mm through the plate at the corners, centered at (X, Y) = (+/-46, +/-31).
